extension.summary: Twelve skins for Kodi 21 Omega, designed for the TV.
extension.description: Majan, Void, Orbit, Daylight, Duotone, Sentence, Passe-partout, Nocturne, Six Degrees, Fold, Keepsake and Groove: skins designed for the TV and tested on an NVIDIA Shield, plus two optional helper add-ons. Install a skin from this repository and its updates arrive automatically.
extension.news: Fixes the repository hanging or showing 'Could not connect' right after it is installed on Kodi 21: the add-on list now comes from raw.githubusercontent.com, so it no longer queues behind the site's other downloads.
